ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Fil.]

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Fil.]
Gnawing and boring in bowels, < eating sweet things ; constipation ; loss of appetite ; furred tongue ; pale face ; blue rings around eyes ; itching of nose ; irritable and cross. θ Worms.
Symptoms indicative of worms, particularly when constipation is present.
A woman who had repeatedly passed segments of tape-worm was seized with severe colic which quickly disappeared under Filix mas, and was followed eight days later by discharge of tape-worm, 50 inches in length.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Fil.]
Sterility.
   

FEVER. [40] [Fil.]
Worm fever.
